notes.title: Denshi Life 2 is released today!
notes.content:
New game modes, new missions, added interventions. Released today with new elements while maintaining the simplicity of its predecessor. Once again, sound is by Yuriko Keino. In response to many requests, a version of Namco PCB's sound from the arcade games of the time has also been included.
Of course, it is also compatible with KORG's nano Kontrol2.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176490/Denshi_Life_2___2/

notes.title: New achievement i4004
notes.content:
New achievement "i4004" has been added.
It is unlocked when you shoot 4004 or more lives during one game!
